# wind_kit

> Tailwind CSS for Flutter: `className` strings such as `flex p-4 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800` become optimised Flutter widget trees. W-prefix widgets, token parsers, a `WindThemeData` of token scales, responsive, `dark:`, state and platform prefixes, `WindRecipe` variant composition and `WDynamic` server-driven UI. Stable 1.x, MIT.

**Stack**: Flutter >=3.47.0 · Dart >=3.13.0 · Runtime deps: `flutter_svg`, `material_ui`, `wind_kit_diagnostics_contracts`. No state management library, no router, no mocking library.

**Setup**:

```bash
flutter pub add wind_kit material_ui
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:wind_kit/wind_kit.dart';

void main() {
  // Debug and profile only: lets tools such as tapir read widget state.
  if (!kReleaseMode) {
    Wind.installDebugResolver();
  }

  runApp(
    WindTheme(
      data: WindThemeData(),
      builder: (context, controller) => MaterialApp(
        theme: controller.toThemeData(),
        home: Scaffold(
          body: WDiv(
            className: 'p-6 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-lg',
            child: WText('Hello', className: 'text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white'),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

**Prefix stack** in a className: `<state>:<breakpoint>:<dark>:<platform>:<utility>`. The last class in a family wins. An unknown family is dropped with a one-time `kDebugMode` hint (release builds stay silent); a known family with an unsupported value drops silently. Every colour token (`bg-` / `text-` / `border-` / `fill-` / `ring-` / `shadow-`) carries a `dark:` pair in the same className.

**Parser cache key**: the alias-expanded `className + activeBreakpoint + brightness + platform + sorted(activeStates)`. A call that passes a `baseStyle` skips the cache. The key omits the theme's maps: call `WindParser.clearCache()` in test `setUp`, and after `setTheme` / `updateTheme` changes anything but brightness.

## API

- Widgets (one barrel, `package:wind_kit/wind_kit.dart`): layout `WDiv`, `WSpacer`, `WBreakpoint`, `WCard`, `WBadge`; display `WText`, `WIcon`, `WImage`, `WSvg`; interactive `WAnchor`, `WButton`, `WPopover`, `WTabs`, `WKeyboardActions` (`platform:` takes the string `'all'`, `'ios'` or `'android'`), `WindAnimationWrapper`; form `WInput`, `WSelect`, `WCheckbox`, `WSwitch`, `WRadio`, `WDatePicker`, `WFormInput`, `WFormSelect`, `WFormMultiSelect`, `WFormCheckbox`, `WFormDatePicker`; server-driven `WDynamic` (an allowlist of wind_kit and Flutter core widgets by default; its `builders:`, `denyWidgets:` and `customIcons:` extend or restrict it). `child` XOR `children` on every widget that takes both.
- Theme: `WindTheme` (takes `child` or `builder`), `WindThemeData` (token scales merged over the defaults), `WindThemeController` (`toggleTheme()`, `resetToSystem()`, `toThemeData()`), context extensions `context.windTheme`, `windThemeData`, `windBrightness`, `windIsDark`, `windColors`, `windScreens`, `wActiveBreakpoint`, `wIsMobile`, `wIsTablet`, `wIsDesktop`.
- Parsing: `WindParser.parse(className, context, states:, baseStyle:)` returns an immutable `WindStyle`; `WindThemeData.aliases` maps bare tokens to className strings.
- Composition: `WindRecipe` and `WindSlotRecipe` (base, variant axes, `WindCompoundVariant`, caller className appended last, no dedupe).
- Debug: `Wind.installDebugResolver()` and `Wind.installPerfResolver()` register resolvers in `wind_kit_diagnostics_contracts` (both no-ops in release builds), `WindPerfCounters` (opt-in counters; counting stays off until the host sets `WindPerfCounters.enabled`).

## Platforms

Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows and Linux; the web build is WebAssembly-ready. `ios:` / `android:` / `web:` / `mobile:` / `macos:` / `windows:` / `linux:` prefixes target one platform. Spacing is 4 logical pixels per step and font sizes are pixels, not rem.

## Rules for agents

- Import only `package:wind_kit/wind_kit.dart` for wind_kit; there are no sub-barrels. Import `package:material_ui/material_ui.dart`, not `package:flutter/material.dart`, for `MaterialApp`, `ThemeData`, `Colors` and `MaterialColor`: the Flutter barrel gives "No MaterialLocalizations found" and type mismatches against `WindThemeData` and `controller.toThemeData()`.
- Pair every colour token with its `dark:` peer in the same className, on the same line.
- Never interpolate Dart into a className: route conditions through `states:` and prefixed classes.
- Inside a Row give the child `flex-1`; inside a bounded Column (`flex flex-col h-full`) give the scrolling child `flex-1 overflow-y-auto` and the constructor prop `scrollPrimary: true`. `h-full` on a child of a scrollable parent throws an unbounded height assertion.
- Spell-check token values by hand: a known family with an unsupported value (`text-7xl`, the scale stops at `6xl`; `w-auto`) or a mistyped prefix (`hovr:`) drops silently, and an unknown family (`ps-4`, `-m-4`) drops with a one-time `kDebugMode` hint.
- There is no `group-*`, `peer-*`, `@apply`, container query or `!important`, and no widget tracks press, so `active:` applies only through `states: {'active'}`: track press in your own state and pass it.
- Give an icon-only `WButton` or `WAnchor` a `semanticLabel`, and use `Icons.*_outlined` glyphs.
- In tests call `WindParser.clearCache()` in `setUp`.
- Install the skill for the full grammar: `npx skills add anilcancakir/wind_kit`.

## Docs

### Getting started

- [Installation](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Add wind_kit to a Flutter app, wrap it in `WindTheme` and style your first widget with a className.
- [Upgrade Guide](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/getting-started/upgrade-guide.md): What changed between wind_kit versions and what to edit in your app when you upgrade.

### Core concepts

- [Dark Mode](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/dark-mode.md): Wind makes it incredibly easy to support dark mode using the `dark:` variant modifier.
- [Debugging](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/debugging.md): Print a widget's composition tree with the `debug` token, catch unknown className tokens and expose wind_kit state to tapir.
- [Dynamic Rendering](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/dynamic-rendering.md): Build Flutter UIs from JSON at runtime. WDynamic turns a Map structure into a live widget tree with action handling and form state management.
- [Responsive Design](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/responsive-design.md): Building interfaces that adapt to any screen size is a core requirement for modern applications.
- [State Management & Interactive Styles](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/state-management.md): Style hover, focus, disabled, loading and custom states with prefixed classes and the `states` prop.
- [Theme Binding](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/theme-binding.md): Theme binding allows you to sync your Wind configuration with Flutter's native `ThemeData` system.
- [Theme Configuration](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/theming.md): Configure colours, spacing, typography, breakpoints and animations through `WindThemeData`, and wrap the app in `WindTheme`.
- [Utility-First Fundamentals](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/core-concepts/utility-first.md): Utility-first styling is the core philosophy of Wind.

### Widgets

- [WAnchor](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-anchor.md): The foundational state wrapper that detects hover and focus, runs the gestures you give it and propagates that state down to all descendant widgets via `WindAnchorStateProvider`.
- [WBadge](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-badge.md): Inline status or label pill. Composes a pill-shaped `WDiv` (rounded-full, inline-flex) around a `WText` (text-xs).
- [WBreakpoint](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-breakpoint.md): Declarative breakpoint-keyed builder for rendering different widget trees per responsive breakpoint.
- [WButton](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-button.md): `WButton` is an interactive component that combines `WAnchor` state management with Tailwind-like utility styling and built-in loading states.
- [WCard](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-card.md): Surface container with optional `header` and `footer` slots.
- [WCheckbox](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-checkbox.md): A utility-first checkbox component that translates Tailwind-style classes into a fully customisable checkbox widget.
- [WDatePicker](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-date-picker.md): A utility-first date picker component built on WPopover with support for single date selection, date range selection, date-with-time selection, min/max constraints, and custom display formatting.
- [WDiv](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-div.md): The fundamental building block of Wind. `WDiv` acts as a multi-purpose container that replaces standard Flutter widgets like `Container`, `Row`, `Column`, `Flex`, `Grid`, `Wrap`, and `SingleChildScrollView`.
- [WDynamic](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-dynamic.md): `WDynamic` renders a Flutter widget tree from a JSON/Map configuration at runtime, with built-in action handling and form state management.
- [WFormCheckbox](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-form-checkbox.md): A Wind-styled checkbox that integrates with Flutter's Form validation, providing built-in support for labels, hints, and error states.
- [WFormDatePicker](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-form-date-picker.md): A form-integrated date picker that wraps WDatePicker with Flutter's `FormField<DateTime>`.
- [WFormInput](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-form-input.md): A Wind-styled input that integrates seamlessly with Flutter's native Form validation system.
- [WFormSelect](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-form-select.md): A Wind-styled single or multi-select dropdown that integrates seamlessly with Flutter's Form validation.
- [WIcon](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-icon.md): The utility-first icon component for displaying vector icons with Tailwind-like styling.
- [WImage](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-image.md): The `WImage` widget brings utility-first styling to images in Flutter, providing HTML-like semantics with Tailwind-inspired classes for sizing, object fitting, and decoration.
- [WInput](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-input.md): A utility-first form input that combines React-style controlled state management with Tailwind-like styling.
- [WKeyboardActions](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-keyboard-actions.md): A wrapper that renders a Done button and field-navigation toolbar above the keyboard for any group of input fields, with optional platform targeting and custom close widget.
- [WPopover](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-popover.md): A flexible popover component for creating dropdown menus, notification panels, user menus, tooltips, and similar overlay patterns.
- [WRadio](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-radio.md): Controlled radio button. Composes `WAnchor` (interaction state) + `WDiv` (outer ring shell) + `WDiv` (inner filled indicator).
- [WSelect](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-select.md): A highly customisable, utility-first select component that supports single selection, multi-selection, searching, and remote data fetching.
- [WSpacer](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-spacer.md): The `WSpacer` is a lightweight widget designed specifically for adding consistent gaps between elements.
- [WSvg](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-svg.md): The utility-first SVG component. `WSvg` brings HTML SVG semantics to Flutter with Tailwind-like utility classes for styling, supporting both asset paths and raw SVG strings.
- [WSwitch](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-switch.md): Controlled toggle switch. Composes `WAnchor` + `WDiv` (track) + `WDiv` (thumb).
- [WTabs](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-tabs.md): Controlled tabs widget. Renders a tab list and a content panel.
- [WText](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/w-text.md): A utility-first text component that translates Tailwind-like class strings into optimised Flutter typography.
- [WindAnimationWrapper](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/widgets/wind-animation-wrapper.md): `WindAnimationWrapper` wraps any widget in a looping animation driven by `WindAnimationType`: spin, ping, pulse, or bounce.

### Layout

- [Aspect Ratio](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/aspect-ratio.md): Utilities for controlling the aspect ratio of an element.
- [Display](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/display.md): Utilities for controlling the layout mode of an element.
- [Flexbox & Layout](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/flexbox.md): Utilities for controlling flex containers, direction, alignment, wrapping, and spacing.
- [Grid Template Columns](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/grid.md): Utilities for specifying the columns in a grid layout.
- [Overflow](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/overflow.md): Utilities for controlling how an element handles content that is too large for the container.
- [Positioning](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/positioning.md): Utilities for controlling how elements are positioned in the layout using `relative` and `absolute` placement.
- [Sizing](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/sizing.md): Utilities for setting the width and height of elements.
- [Spacing](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/spacing.md): Utilities for controlling the padding and margin of elements.
- [Z-Index](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/layout/z-index.md): Utilities for controlling the stack order of an element.

### Borders

- [Border Width, Colour, & Radius](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/borders/borders.md): Utilities for controlling border width, colour, style, and border radius.
- [Ring Width, Colour, and Offset](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/borders/ring.md): Utilities for drawing an outline ring around an element.

### Styling

- [Background Colour](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/styling/background-color.md): Utilities for controlling an element's background colour.
- [Background Gradient](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/styling/background-gradient.md): Utilities for creating linear gradients with customisable directions and colour stops.
- [Background Image](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/styling/background-image.md): Utilities for controlling background images, sizing, positioning, and repeat behaviour.
- [Opacity](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/styling/opacity.md): Utilities for controlling the opacity of an element.
- [Shadow](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/styling/shadow.md): Utilities for controlling the box shadow of an element.
- [WindRecipe](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/styling/wind-recipe.md): A `tv()` (tailwind-variants) equivalent for Wind.

### Typography

- [Font Family](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/font-family.md): Utilities for controlling the typeface of text.
- [Font Size](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/font-size.md): Utilities for controlling the font size of an element.
- [Font Weight](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/font-weight.md): Utilities for controlling the font weight of an element.
- [Letter Spacing](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/letter-spacing.md): Utilities for controlling the tracking (letter spacing) of an element.
- [Line Height](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/line-height.md): Utilities for controlling the leading (line height) of an element.
- [Text Align](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/text-align.md): Utilities for controlling the alignment of text.
- [Text Colour](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/text-color.md): Utilities for controlling the text colour of an element.
- [Text Decoration](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/text-decoration.md): Utilities for controlling the decoration of text.
- [Text Overflow](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/text-overflow.md): Utilities for controlling how text behaves when it overflows its container.
- [Text Transform](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/typography/text-transform.md): Utilities for controlling the capitalization and wrapping of text.

### Interactivity

- [Animation](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/interactivity/animation.md): Utilities for animating elements with CSS-like animation classes.
- [Cursor](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/interactivity/cursor.md): Utilities for controlling the mouse cursor shown when the pointer is over an element on web and desktop targets.
- [Transitions](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/interactivity/transition.md): Utilities for controlling the duration and easing of state transitions in Wind.

### Utilities

- [Color Helpers](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/utilities/color-helpers.md): Resolve theme colours, hex values and opacity from Dart with `wColor` and the context helpers.
- [Context Extensions](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/utilities/context-extensions.md): Read theme data, breakpoints, brightness and styling helpers straight from a `BuildContext`.
- [Responsive Helpers](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/utilities/responsive-helpers.md): Responsive helpers provide programmatic access to Wind's breakpoint system, platform detection, and screen metrics directly from your Dart code.
- [Spacing Helpers](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/utilities/spacing-helpers.md): Wind provides programmatic access to your theme's spacing scale through helper functions and extensions.
- [Style Parser](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/utilities/style-parser.md): Parse a className string into a `WindStyle` yourself with `wStyle` and `WindParser.parse`.
- [Typography Helpers](https://anilcancakir.com/wind_kit/docs/utilities/typography-helpers.md): Read the theme's font sizes and weights from Dart with `wFontSize`, `wFontWeight` and their context extensions.
